description: This file defines the interface and classes related to the MediaPipeline component in a media playback system, including factory creation, media pipeline states, and client notifications. It contains class declarations, enums, and method signatures for managing media playback, sources, and IPC communication.

classes.name: MediaPipelineFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IMediaPipeline instances.

classes.name: MediaPipeline
classes.description: Represents a media playback pipeline, managing media sources, states, and IPC communication with the media backend.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates a new IMediaPipeline instance with specified client and video requirements.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media of a specified type with given MIME type and URL.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to the pipeline.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source by ID.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video display window parameters.

methods.name: addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment for streaming.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the media pipeline client.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Notifies a change in playback state.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Notifies a change in playback position.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Notifies that media data is needed.
